The Utah Jazz (1-9, 15th in the West) host the Miami Heat (3-6, 9th in the East) in Utah's 11th game of the season, with the Jazz 1-4 at home, 0-5 on the road, and on an eight-game losing streak. Miami enters on a one-game skid and sits 3 games back in the Southeast, while Utah is 7 games back in the Northwest. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Jazz winning the most recent meeting 115-111 in Miami on February 9, 2026.

Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain) are all out for Utah, and Keyonte George is day-to-day with an ankle injury and listed as a game-time decision.
